directive: Preserve the CivicState repo narrative while holding it at watchlist until paid demand, deliverability, and official-data coverage are validated.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record
one_liner: Watchlist civic-letter tool: real repo surface, unproven paid demand and deliverability.

sources.method: read existing business and financial plan
read current project soul and validation gates

planningMethod: EIR workspace review: repo evidence first, external claims marked as assumptions, contradictions raised as surprise spikes.

customer.primary: Individual United States resident with a civic issue who wants a researched constituent letter
validationNeeded: Paid conversion from preview to checkout

market.method: Bottom-up early reachable audience model because network research was unavailable

tam.label: not claimed
tam.basis: Top-down civic participation TAM would be hand-waving without network research

sam.basis: 50,000 issue-intent visitors x 3% conversion x $18 AOV

som.basis: 400 monthly submissions x $18 AOV x 12 months, annualized from MASTER_PLAN.md scenario

revenueAssumptions.claim: AOV can reach $18 in the base case
Month Twelve target is 400 submissions per month

costAssumptions.claim: Phase One fixed costs are about $200 per month

sensitivityTests.name: deliverability miss
sensitivityTests.honesty: evidence for threshold, assumption for action

sensitivityTests.name: cost overrun
sensitivityTests.case: variable and payment costs rise to 20% of revenue
sensitivityTests.impact: unit economics remain positive but trust and support risk increase

competition.basis: Named or implied in MASTER_PLAN.md and .planning/PROJECT.md; external details treated as assumptions in BUSINESS.md

antiPlan.summary: This can fail because users may not pay, officials may not receive emails, official data may be brittle, and the legal-advice boundary may create unacceptable risk.

holes.mitigation: Run real paid beta before investment posture
holes.residualRisk: Users may like previews but refuse checkout
Local data may be costly or stale
Users may rely on output as legal advice

strategy: Narrow paid individual constituent workflow first; no organization API, coalition mechanics, or channel expansion before validation.

goToMarket.firstWedge: Single metro, constrained issue categories, paid beta

operatorWorkflow.daily: Review flagged submissions, delivery failures, treasury discrepancies, and bounced officials

constraints: Registry says watchlist and personal/research asset
Workspace-only research; no external sources fetched
Civic communications only; not legal advice, filings, claims, or lobbying firm
Sensitive political/civic opinion data requires encryption, retention, and deletion discipline

requirements: Human review for threats, defamation risk, legal-demand posture, and unverifiable claims
No fabricated citations or official contact data

unknowns: Whether operator wants brooks-history/CivicState pitched as a business
Whether WrkPlug replaces current Clerk/Stripe rails

assumptionLedger.test: Replace with actual traffic and conversion

assumptionLedger.claim: WrkPlug shared rails reduce platform work
Official-contact data can become a moat
